suppress.notes: log4j-api is only the log4j-to-slf4j bridge (Logback is the real logging impl). These CVEs target log4j-core's Rfc5424Layout, which DigiBank does not use. Details: WORKSHOP2-TRACEABILITY-REPORT.md.

Not applicable: these CVEs target Spring WebFlux, RSocket, SpEL evaluation, XsltView with wildcard mappings, UrlHandlerFilter/UrlFileNameViewController, FreeMarker, or HTML form-tag error rendering. DigiBank uses plain spring-boot-starter-web (servlet MVC + Thymeleaf) only; none of these features are used anywhere in the codebase (verified by code search). No fixed Spring Framework release (6.2.20+/3.5.x) is available yet without a Spring Boot 4.x major jump. Details: WORKSHOP2-TRACEABILITY-REPORT.md.
CVE-2025-15104 actually targets "Nu Html Checker" (validator.nu), an unrelated tool wrongly CPE-matched against hibernate-validator due to the shared generic "validator:validator" product name.

False positive: CVE-2025-7962 describes an SMTP injection issue in "Jakarta Mail versions prior to 2.0.2". The artifact present here (angus-activation 2.0.3) is already newer than the stated fix version, and it is the MIME/activation framework artifact, not the angus-mail/Jakarta Mail messaging implementation the CVE actually targets (Dependency-Check's CPE match here has Low confidence: cpe:eclipse:angus_mail matched against angus-activation). DigiBank does not send email; this is a transitive dependency. Reviewed 2026-09-09.
